description: Swiss work permit quotas for people from outside the EU/EFTA, set every year by the Federal Council (VZAE annexes 1 and 2): B and L permits per canton plus the federal reserve, and the separate quotas for EU/EFTA service providers over 90 days, UK nationals without acquired rights and US interns, with the admission rules (economic interest, priority of the domestic workforce, qualified workers only) and their law articles. canton optional.

year.description: Quota year, e.g. 2026; omit for the latest Federal Council decision.

name: work_permit_quotas
title: Work permit quotas
